sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr. Utkarsh Sharma waives service of Rule on behalf of the respondent - State.
2. By way of this application, the applicant prays for being released on parole leave for the purpose of filing appeal against the order of conviction.
3. Perusal of the Jail remarks would indicate that applicant had been convicted for the offence under Section 376(d) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to life imprisonment.
It also appears that up till now, the applicant has undergone approximately 3 years, 7 months and 28 days of incarceration.
It would further appear that till date, the applicant has never been released on any leave whatsover R/SCR.A/3765/2023 ORDER DATED: 23/03/2023 including on temporary bail.
Jail conduct of the applicant also appears to be good.

4. Considering the same, while this Court is inclined to release the present applicant but at the same time, since it would for the first time for the applicant to be released, appropriate safeguards are also required to be put in place.

In view of the same, the jail authority to release the applicant on parole Ramabhai Abhabhai Vadi vs State Of Gujarat on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196220030/
1 leave for a period of 15 days from the date of actual release on executing personal bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) before the Jail authority and on usual terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Jail Authority.

sentences.text: 5. The applicant shall mark his presence before the Himmatnagar 'A' Division Police Station on 5th and 10th day of his release.

The applicant convict to surrender before Jail Authority on completion of parole leave, without fail.
6.
With these observations and directions, the application stands disposed of as allowed.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
